description: This file defines an interface for Analytics Backends within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the IAnalyticsBackend interface with methods for configuration and sending events, as well as an Event structure to encapsulate event data. It also includes external dependencies and a type alias for a shared pointer to the interface.

classes.name: IAnalyticsBackend
classes.description: Interface for analytics backend implementations, providing methods for configuration and event transmission, along with an embedded Event data structure.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the analytics backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics backend with the provided shell, system time, and local store.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an analytics event to the backend.
